explanation: The hypothesis addresses the broad engineering goal and proposes a controlled, threshold-based falsification test, so it is experimentally discriminating. However, it has essentially no agreement with the hidden study, which examined equiatomic CrFeTaVW versus CrFeTiVW, hybrid MC/MD segregation predictions, ball milling, SPS consolidation, and thermal diffusivity from 300 to 1000 K. The target found that Ta-to-Ti substitution changed phase constitution but did not materially improve diffusivity; both alloys remained far below W and CuCrZr. The generated mechanism is speculative, lacks cited evidence, and assumes Cu/Ag solid-solution stability without defining the host composition. Its temperature range overlaps the target only broadly, and mechanical loading is not quantitatively specified. Thus it is a testable idea but not an evidence-supported reconstruction or a sufficiently grounded alternative.
